description: E40 at the model level, a sentence becomes a task: a session is told to remind the owner to call the plumber on Friday, and after a curation run the task list holds one open task about the plumber, due that Friday, and no review task asking the owner to check it. On a Friday, "on Friday" may mean that day or the next one, and both count. Not compared: Claude Code's own memory keeps no task list with a day. Three wordings, one in German.

wordings.remind: Remind me to call the plumber on Friday.
Erinnere mich daran, am Freitag den Klempner anzurufen.
Don't let me forget the call to the plumber, on Friday.

run: import datetime; t = datetime.date.today(); n = t + datetime.timedelta(days=(4 - t.weekday()) % 7 or 7); print(n.isoformat(), (t if t.weekday() == 4 else n).isoformat())
